reason: Integrates a user-configured external vision model to analyze images and return textual, optionally coordinate-based visual evidence for text-only conversational models.

summaries.zh: 将用户提供的图片交给配置的外部视觉模型分析，并把带有可选坐标信息的文字视觉证据返回给纯文本对话模型。
summaries.en: Sends user-provided images to a configured external vision model and returns textual visual evidence, optionally with coordinates, to text-only conversation models.

capabilities: Sends user-provided images or image URLs to a configured external vision-model API
Requests available models from the configured API endpoint
Stores and uses a user-provided API key for authenticated requests
Caches session-level visual evidence for follow-up questions
